title: Embedded Systems Specialist
description:
About the job:

Company Description HBeonLabs Technologies Private Limited is an ISO 9001:2015 certified electronics and IoT solutions company established in 2008, specializing in GSM-based security systems and customized RFID+GPRS+GPS solutions. The organization focuses on end-to-end services, from research and design to manufacturing and deployment of embedded and IoT products tailored to client requirements and budgets. By integrating sensors, connectivity, and cloud-based applications, HBeonLabs enables smarter decision-making and improved product performance for businesses ranging from startups to large enterprises. The company emphasizes reliable, secure, and innovative solutions with fast, on-time delivery and a strong commitment to quality throughout the product development lifecycle. With deep experience in embedded system technologies, HBeonLabs aims to build long-term partnerships by ensuring high customer satisfaction.
Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Embedded Software Developer (RTOS + OpenCPU) role based in Noida. The Embedded Software Developer will design, implement, and maintain embedded software for IoT and electronics products, with a focus on RTOS-based and OpenCPU platforms. Responsibilities include developing firmware modules, integrating drivers and communication stacks (e.g., GSM, GPRS, GPS, RFID), and optimizing code for reliability, performance, and memory usage. The role involves debugging and troubleshooting hardware-software integration issues, using tools such as logic analyzers, debuggers, and protocol analyzers. The developer will collaborate closely with hardware, QA, and product teams to refine requirements, support prototyping, prepare technical documentation, and assist in product validation and field issue resolution.

Strong skills in Embedded Software Programming and Embedded Software development for microcontrollers and SoCs on OpnCPU and RTOS.
Proficiency in Software Development practices, including version control, build systems, and testing for embedded environments.
Ability to perform effective Debugging of embedded systems, including hardware-software integration and RTOS-related issues.
Experience in Software Design for real-time and resource-constrained systems, including modular architecture and code optimization.
Hands-on experience with RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS or similar) and OpenCPU-based platforms for GSM/4G modules.
Good understanding of communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, TCP/IP, MQTT) and sensor/actuator interfacing.
Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to read schematics, collaborate with hardware teams, and document designs and test cases clearly.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and willingness to work on-site in a collaborative, fast-paced product environment

title: Game QA Tester
description:
Key Responsibilities:

1. Build and verify build verification and release testing by quickly checking every new build to make sure it's stable, and run full testing on builds that are ready for release across a set range of high-end and budget Android and iOS devices, different OS versions, and screen sizes
2. Create defect documentation by writing bug reports anyone can follow without asking questions, including exact steps to reproduce, expected versus actual results, device, OS version, build number, account used, and attaching screenshots, screen recordings, and crash logs from Crashlytics or logcat
3. Perform triage and prioritisation by deciding the severity and urgency of each bug, checking for duplicate reports, linking related bugs to identify recurring issues, and explaining the reasoning behind prioritisation decisions
4. Conduct fix verification by retesting resolved bugs using the original reproduction steps and testing surrounding areas to ensure the fix has not introduced new issues
5. Manage regression testing by retesting existing features before every release to confirm new changes have not broken them and adding permanent test cases for previously escaped bugs
6. Maintain test coverage and documentation by writing and updating test cases and checklists based on design documents, removing obsolete tests, and identifying untested areas
7. Validate the core experience by testing the new player experience, level unlocks, rewards, and save data persistence across sessions, reinstalls, and device switches
8. Monitor performance and stability testing by tracking frame rate, loading times, memory usage, battery consumption, and app size across devices while identifying slowdowns during extended gameplay
9. Execute edge case and stress testing by checking game behaviour under weak or unstable networks, app minimisation, force closure, low storage or memory, overheating, account switching, multiple devices, and gameplay limits
10. Handle release and post-launch support by completing App Store and Google Play submission checklists, ensuring compliance with store requirements, and monitoring crash reports and store reviews after launch
11. Collaborate with the team by participating in sprint planning and stand-ups, raising testing risks early, working closely with developers to identify root causes of bugs, and sharing gameplay feedback beyond functional issues
12. Perform localisation and UI testing by ensuring text displays correctly in all supported languages without truncation and verifying layouts across different screen sizes and aspect ratios

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
About the job:

We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain firmware for microcontroller-based systems. The ideal candidate has strong C/C++ skills, a solid grasp of embedded systems fundamentals, and can read hardware documentation and schematics while working closely with our hardware team.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Design, implement, test, and maintain modular embedded firmware for microcontroller-based systems.
2. Own firmware subsystems independently, including communication stacks, state machines, RTOS-based software architecture, and application logic, from specification through deployment.
3. Develop firmware for interfacing with sensors, communication peripherals, actuators, and motor control systems using vendor SDKs and middleware.
4. Design firmware that is reliable, fault-tolerant, and maintainable for long-term field deployment.
5. Develop, integrate, and troubleshoot firmware-level communication interfaces, spanning wired protocols (UART, SPI, I C, CAN, RS-485), wireless/mesh technologies (Wi-Fi, BLE, LoRa, Zigbee, Thread), and networked/industrial protocols (Ethernet, Modbus RTU/TCP).
6. Debug firmware issues using JTAG/SWD debuggers and instrumentation/logging.
7. Write unit and integration tests where feasible; contribute to build systems, automation scripts, and CI workflows using Git, CMake, and Python.
8. Read schematics and datasheets to understand hardware behavior and firmware constraints; participate in schematic reviews from a firmware perspective.
9. Prepare technical documentation including architecture documents, interface specifications, and build/release notes to support manufacturing, deployment, and field troubleshooting.
10. Collaborate with hardware and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
